title: State and output transition rule
statement: For a finite-tape Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input symbols, a state-output summary $(q,r)$, and read data $\rho$, define the updated summary as follows. If $q$ is absent, retain $(q,r)$; if $q$ is present, apply the machine transition using the input and work-tape symbols in $\rho$, take its resulting state, and push its output onto $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine M with Boolean input symbols
